jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 25c (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/lane-pass-routing.mjs, tools/managers/lane-health/index.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/lane-pass-routing.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/lane-pass-routing.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- SENSITIVE (routing). Line 93 `} catch { // A run may be incomplete or concurrently unavailable; keep the readable runs. }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (run's state.json missing or torn), log the rest; no fallback value, the run is simply left out of `runStates`.
- Line 123 `} catch { // A run may be incomplete or concurrently unavailable; keep the readable runs. }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (same, sync variant), log the rest; no fallback value, run left out of `runStates`.

### tools/managers/lane-health/index.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/managers/lane-health/index.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- SENSITIVE (routing). Line 57 `const st = await fs.stat(manifestFile).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (run's manifest.json not written yet/incomplete run), log the rest; keep null fallback (guarded by `if (st && st.isFile() ...)`).
- Line 93 `const st = await fs.stat(manifestFile).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (same, latest-id variant), log the rest; keep null fallback (guarded the same way).

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
